question: Should the experimental Claws stack adopt `CLAW.md` as its canonical exported manifest format while retaining JSON only as an accepted input format?
rationale: This changes the package artifact that future Claw authors and tools consume, and the base lifecycle work is not yet merged into current main; source review cannot substitute for maintainer acceptance of that package contract.

options.title: Sponsor the canonical format
options.body: Accept `CLAW.md` as the experimental export contract, require exact-head lifecycle proof, and merge this slice only after its lifecycle stack base is accepted.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical
options.body: Retain JSON as the generated export artifact and limit Markdown support to an optional input adapter if human authoring remains desirable.

options.title: Pause the format decision
options.body: Hold this slice until the lifecycle stack or RFC settles the intended package interchange contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the canonical format
recommendation.body: Accept `CLAW.md` as the experimental export contract, require exact-head lifecycle proof, and merge this slice only after its lifecycle stack base is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the visible author across the current and prior CLAW.md stack slices and can provide the implementation and proof context for the product decision.
